style.backgroundSystem: seamless #FFFFFF for packshots, matte #22272B for work scenes, light neutral #E7EFE7 for flat lays and pain-point panels, real material surfaces at true hex for lifestyle scenes
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons inside one rounded pill or hexagon outline, accent color only
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light with front key and fill card on product screens; directional daylight-grade scene light at 5500K-6500K with soft skimming highlight over the hands; believable contact shadows under every object
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium utilitarian ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, matte charcoal #22272B, light neutral green-grey #E7EFE7 and one product-matched accent color; neutral studio lighting with a front key, fill card and believable soft contact shadows, daylight-grade scene light at 5500K to 6500K; modern geometric sans-serif; single thin-line icon style inside rounded pill or hexagon outlines; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; hands and forearms only with no face in frame; stable worn-product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no printed packaging artwork.
noDrift: no printed packaging artwork or wordmarks
style.presentationRules: hands and forearms only, no face in frame; worn-glove angle kept consistent across the set; callout panel always anchored to one corner and never covering the product
style.surfaceSystem: brushed steel #8C9196, used prep counter #6E6A66, butcher paper #F0E4D2, matte neutral board #E7EFE7
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, headline plus two or three short label lines only
